sentences.en: Today’s spacecraft use rockets and rockets use large quantities of propellant.
sentences.zh: 如今的航天器使用火箭，而火箭则需要大量喷射剂。

sentences.en: You can stop the thrust of a liquid rocket by turning off the flow of propellants.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过关闭推进剂的流动来停止液体火箭的推力。

sentences.en: The propellant in the firework makes it burst into colorful sparks.
sentences.zh: 烟花中的推进剂让它迸发出五彩斑斓的火花。
